data.one_liner: Provides a simple page-turning transition effect for page routes and page views.
data.what_it_does: The package offers a page-turning animation effect that can be used as a custom PageRoute, integrated into ThemeData for global transitions, applied via GoRoute's custom transition page, or used as a TurnPageView widget.
use_when: You want to add book-like page-turning animations to your app routes or page views.
You want to integrate a page-turning transition with GoRouter or custom navigators.
avoid_when: You require standard platform-native page transitions without custom book effects.
strengths: Easy to integrate with standard Navigator, GoRouter, or ThemeData.
Includes both transition routes and a dedicated TurnPageView widget.
Provides customizable properties like overleaf color, direction, and stroke styling.
weaknesses: Niche animation style that may not fit most modern UI design systems.

alternatives.name: page_transition
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a large collection of standard transition animations rather than just a page-turn effect.

alternatives.name: flutter_animate
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers a general-purpose, fluent API for animating widgets rather than specialized page routes.
